notes: SBLGNT.ACT.28.17.v023 is underdetermined on the base reading, which carries ἄνδρες; the ASV compresses the vocative pair to brethren, so ἄνδρες stands unrepresented within this verse rather than as a rule 97 surplus token, the base reading being one the English can carry.
πρώτους takes the supplied the as a rule 7/51 helper because it is anarthrous — the article τούς is spent on those, the pronoun rule 32 gives it before ὄντας.
The concessive though … yet frame rides with ποιήσας, the participle carrying the subordination; marking yet added remains defensible.
The ASV's alternative-rendering note does not change the token partition.
